umm.EntryTitle: NISAR Provisional Range Doppler Single Look Complex Product (Version 1)

Characteristics.Name: LookDirection
Characteristics.Description: Direction the sensor is pointed, SAR imagery is taken with the sensor pointing either left or right of the satellite.

Characteristics.Name: LookDirection
Characteristics.Description: Direction the sensor is pointed, SAR imagery is taken with the sensor pointing either left or right of the satellite.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: ASCENDING_DESCENDING
AdditionalAttributes.Description: Describes whether the satellite travel direction was ascending towards the north pole, or descending towards the south pole.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: TRACK_NUMBER
AdditionalAttributes.Description: The track describes a path the satellite will follow over the earth similar to longitude; each path has an assigned number. Combined with a frame number it identifies a specific piece of ground. May also be referred to as relative orbit or path number.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: FRAME_NUMBER
AdditionalAttributes.Description: The designated frame or scene as defined by the mission or project. A frame typically describes a fixed geometry over the Earth at a fixed location.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: FREQUENCY_A_POLARIZATION
AdditionalAttributes.Description: Polarization of Frequency A. Radar transmissions are polarized, with components normally termed vertical (V) and horizontal (H). Vertical means that the electric vector is in the plane of incidence; horizontal means the electric vector is perpendicular to the plane of incidence.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: FREQUENCY_B_POLARIZATION
AdditionalAttributes.Description: Polarization of Frequency B. Radar transmissions are polarized, with components normally termed vertical (V) and horizontal (H). Vertical means that the electric vector is in the plane of incidence; horizontal means the electric vector is perpendicular to the plane of incidence.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: PRODUCT_VERSION
AdditionalAttributes.Description: Version of the product.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: PROCESSING_CENTER
AdditionalAttributes.Description: Processing center of the granule.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: FREQUENCIES
AdditionalAttributes.Description: The frequencies found in the data product (A, B, or both). NISAR is a dual-frequency mission.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: FULL_FRAME
AdditionalAttributes.Description: Indicates if the frame coverage is either full or partial.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: FREQUENCY_A_RANGE_BANDWIDTH
AdditionalAttributes.Description: The range bandwidth of frequency A.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: FREQUENCY_B_RANGE_BANDWIDTH
AdditionalAttributes.Description: The range bandwidth of frequency B.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: RANGE_BANDWIDTH_CONCAT
AdditionalAttributes.Description: Concatenated list with plus signs of the frequency A and B range bandwidth.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: JOINT_OBSERVATION
AdditionalAttributes.Description: Indicates whether the granule was observed jointly with the L-Band and S-Band  instrument.  For interferometric products this value is True if either the reference or secondary granule is a joint observation.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: PROCESSING_LEVEL
AdditionalAttributes.Description: Indicates how much processing has been done to the data. Examples include L0 (Level0), L1 (Level 1), L2 (Level 2).

AdditionalAttributes.Name: PRODUCT_TYPE
AdditionalAttributes.Description: Indicates the type of product.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: PRODUCT_TYPE_DESC
AdditionalAttributes.Description: Description of the product type.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: PRODUCTION_PIPELINE
AdditionalAttributes.Description: Indicates whether the product was created as part of nominal data processing, urgent response processing, or customized on-demand processing.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: FREQUENCY_A_POLARIZATION_CONCAT
AdditionalAttributes.Description: Concatenated list with plus signs of the frequency A polarization.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: FREQUENCY_B_POLARIZATION_CONCAT
AdditionalAttributes.Description: Concatenated list with plus signs of the frequency B polarization.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: ORBIT_TYPE
AdditionalAttributes.Description: The accuracy or fidelity of the orbit ephemeris data used to produce the product, where FOE=Forecast Orbit Ephemeris, NOE=Near real-time Orbit Ephemeris, MOE=Medium precision Orbit Ephemeris, and POE=Precise Orbit Ephemeris.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: STACK_ID
AdditionalAttributes.Description: An ASF generated identifier to allow grouping of data over a specific location.

AdditionalAttributes.Name: INPUT_RCID
AdditionalAttributes.Description: The radar configuration mode of the input Level 0B granule(s).
